assertions.name: Multi-knot HOMFLYPT PSLQ — no closure relation expected for either target
assertions.source: mpmath.pslq at max_coef=10^5, tol=1e-12 on a 12-element basis of HOMFLYPT polynomial values for {3_1, 4_1, 5_2, 𝓑_3} × α ∈ {q_0, q_0⁻¹, q_0^{1/2}}. A negative result complements Tier 6 by closing off the 'deep HOMFLYPT recursion COULD produce' caveat in 3a1b11069's Strategy J scalar-ratio probe. Combined with the 8-search cumulative case in 00083b94e, the Bring-Bloch + HOMFLYPT axes are now both retired as λ_scale closure candidates.

description: Strategy J deep dive: PSLQ search across a 12-element basis of HOMFLYPT polynomial values for {3_1, 4_1, 5_2, 𝓑_3} evaluated at α ∈ {q_0, q_0⁻¹, q_0^{1/2}}, z = q_0 − q_0⁻¹. Two targets: (T1) post-Yekutieli residual (3/4)·h², (T2) λ_p_codata directly. Formally tests Strategy J's 'deep recursion COULD produce' caveat. Expected confirmatory negative per 8-search cumulative case (00083b94e).
